listing.name: Armour Visualiser
listing.summary: does what it says on the tin. (and also weapon arcs) updated for .98, no crashes afaik, yell at me if it does
listing.aiSummary: Visualises ship armour coverage and weapon arcs on the battle map.

description: Displays green grid overlays to show armour zones and yellow outlines for weapon arcs. It also includes a visualiser for escort package range, which can be toggled with a keybind found in the settings menu.
